trace.facts: Both load closures independently call Publication.admit(epub()). FailingWrites.fail is false and its saveReading awaits MemoryResume.saveReading. The temporary trace prints only after this delegate completes.
MemoryResume.saveReading applies ReadingChanges to values[accountKey]. The diagnostic prints that stored resume and its encoded anchor, plus the stored history, before reopen.

acceptVisible causes the save through existing record operations. _save enqueues into _pendingWrites; _retryPending serializes saves; flush waits for the pending work. _open takes stored candidates through _compatible.

ReaderDocument.restore requires the saved original-file digest, policy and engine to match. It returns null for the diagnostic second archive, and ReaderSession reports the incompatible source while retaining the old records.

ArchiveFile.lastModTime lazily defaults to DateTime.now in epoch seconds. ZipEncoder converts it to local date/time and stores seconds divided by two. Relevant dependency source excerpts are retained in source-audit.txt.gz.

terms.sourceDigest: The SHA-256 fingerprint of every byte of the original EPUB archive, including its ZIP entry metadata.
terms.publicationIdentity: The admitted-publication key derived from its original-file digest and the admission policy/revision.
terms.entryPayload: The uncompressed bytes of one named file inside the EPUB archive.
terms.archiveEntryTime: The entry modification time supplied in epoch seconds. ZIP stores local calendar components with two-second resolution.
terms.CFI: EPUB Canonical Fragment Identifier: the location string compared by the existing restart test.
terms.successfulSave: The ReaderSession save call completed through FailingWrites into MemoryResume.saveReading, which applied ReadingChanges to its account map. This is an in-process storage double, not physical disk persistence.
